title: wave-phased-swap-conductor-with-circuit-breaker-and-rollback-heuristics
author: Asha Rao
release_notes: Introduces a wave-based swap conductor that performs phased traffic handoffs with an embedded circuit-breaker heuristic and automatic rollback triggers. Improves safety of multi-wave canaries and reduces blast radius for model swaps.
description: Context: Large model swaps have been brittle for stateful session workloads and high-concurrency routes. Existing cohort canaries either move too fast or require manual gating. This PR implements a wave-phased swap conductor that coordinates a sequence of controlled swap waves, observes safety signals, and engages a circuit-breaker that halts progress and executes automated rollback heuristics when prespecified thresholds are breached. Design: The conductor maintains a lightweight state machine (WAVE_IDLE -> WAVE_IN_PROGRESS -> WAVE_VALIDATION -> WAVE_COMMIT) and a sliding safety window that evaluates multiple signals (P50/P95 latency, error-rate, token-quality regression via eval hook, and request-drop). A circuit-breaker with exponential backoff pauses wave advancement and can fast-fail to rollback if sustained violations are observed. Rollback heuristics prefer incremental reversion to the last known-good variant and record a rollback-journal for postmortem playback. Implementation summary: 1) controller/service: new services/rollout/wave_conductor.py implementing the state machine, validation adapters, and circuit-breaker. 2) runtime integration: non-blocking swap path in serving runtime to allow partial route attachment during wave windows. 3) observability: new rollout trace spans, per-wave metrics, and a canary-dashboard view. 4) console: operator UI to visualize wave progression and manually apply or abort waves. 5) CRD updates and helm charts for the new rollout strategy. Testing and validation: unit tests for state transitions, integration canary simulation harness added under tests/integration/test_wave_phasing.py, and performance smoke tests to verify no regression in steady-state latency. CI: integration-canary job runs wave simulations using historical traffic traces. Rollout plan: staged rollout to Dedicated clusters (5% of clusters first) with feature flag rollout.wave_conductor enabled. Early-warning Linear task ENG-4127 tracks production telemetry for 72 hours; auto-disable path present if any cluster shows repeated circuit-breaker activation. Related: builds on work in ENG-3981 (traffic-mirroring abstractions) and complements the recent rollback-journal PR. Checklist: [x] controller + state machine implemented [x] runtime swap hooks added [x] observability and tracing added [x] integration tests and simulation harness [x] docs and operator runbook written. Follow-ups: add continuous eval integration to compare semantic drift for embedding-based rerankers (ENG-4199).

notes_for_changelog: Add: wave-phased swap conductor (opt-in) with circuit-breaker and automated rollback heuristics. Improves safety for multi-wave canaries and reduces risk during large model swaps.
safety_considerations: Circuit-breaker is conservative by default with cluster-scoped defaults. Per-tenant overrides require admin RBAC. Automatic rollback preserves rollback-journal for replay and forensics. Stateful migration is opt-in to reduce risk.
